title: Libre OOP algorithm no data / missed signal
symptom: When using the out of process Libre algorithm, xDrip+ stops showing new data and shows a signal missed message. Deselecting the algorithm makes it work again.
cause: The issue was not definitively resolved; the user initially had trouble installing the OOP algorithm APK, but after installing it correctly it worked. Later, after changing sensors, readings differed from the Libre reader, but no root cause was established.
fix: The user resolved the initial problem by installing the OOP algorithm APK correctly (with Android Studio on the computer). Later, after sensor change, the issue persisted and no fix was confirmed.
evidence_quote: Thank you for your help, it's working as it should now. Readings are the same as libre and updates just as regularly.
